response.rationale: Both localized answers fit the technology sense: Indonesian menggulir and Malaysian menatal. The English cue and sense are aligned, and different-common-word is an appropriate relation. No false-friend contrast is supplied or required. Malaysian skrol is chiefly a noun and should not replace menatal as the standard verb.
